state.project: Miu World: a 3D voxel learn-while-playing online game for all ages (web, mobile later). Owner's north star: lively, never boring. Built 100% by AI; models only from CC0 packs or generated by code; UI must look like the themed mock scenes, never plain white modals.
state.owner_report: Tapping the pet shows a strange message (fixed today: a quest 'nothing here' line). The pet features, animations and appeal are still simple and not attractive.
current_pets: 50 pet species to choose; the pet follows the player with idle/walk/run/dance clips from its model and dances when she celebrates.

A plain white care panel: paw icon (not the pet's picture), friendship stars, three bars (happy, full, clean), four buttons (feed, stroke, bathe, play) that only change numbers on the server; nothing happens in the 3D world.
Shop already sells pet food and toys; collectibles, home decoration and cooking exist; NPC friendships and achievements exist.

first_batch.instructions: What should the first pet batch include?

criteria.scenes_reactions_tricks: Care happens in the world (a bowl appears and the pet eats with crumbs, bath bubbles, a ball to fetch, hearts when stroked, naps with zzz), the pet reacts to the player (cheers when a quest ends, greets her back, sits when she sits, plays near her), a themed care panel with the pet's own picture; plus pet levels that unlock tricks (sit, spin, jump, roll, high-five) the player can ask for, pet accessories from the shop, and a pet bed at home.
criteria.scenes_and_reactions_only: Only in-world care scenes, reactions and the themed panel; levels, tricks and accessories later.
criteria.everything_incl_quests: All of the above plus the pet helping in quests and pet minigames in the same batch.

pet_helps.instructions: Should the pet help in quests?

criteria.sniff_hint: Yes: on a search/find step the pet can sniff and run a few steps toward the nearest item not yet found (a gentle hint, never the answer to a question).
criteria.no_help: No: the pet is only a companion.

needs_over_time.instructions: Should the pet's bars drop over real time?

criteria.slow_drop_never_sad: Drop slowly while away so care has a reason, but never below a cheerful floor; the pet is never sad, sick or lost and nothing is taken away.
criteria.never_drop: Bars only rise; no reason to come back but no pressure.
